home.aboutPreview: We are a registered, small-scale village farm focused on quality rather than quantity. Currently, we care for around 10 cows and operate a small dairy unit. We also support local farmers by collecting fresh milk when available.
home.trustDescription: Fixed pricing, transparent process, and long-term trust with village customers.

about.title: About Us
about.story:
Hare Krishna Krishi tatha Pashu Panchhi Farm was started to provide clean and reliable dairy products to our local community. We believe small farms can deliver better quality, care, and honesty than large commercial setups.

Our dairy operates with fixed pricing, simple record-keeping, and a monthly credit system trusted by village families.
about.mission: To serve our village with fresh, pure dairy products through honest practices and personal care.

products.title: Our Products
products.subtitle: All products are prepared using traditional methods with fixed pricing.

milkCollection.title: Milk Collection & Credit System
milkCollection.collectionDescription: In addition to milk from our own cows, we collect fresh milk from nearby farms and village households when required. All milk is checked before storage and processing.
milkCollection.creditDescription: Village customers can take milk and dairy products on monthly credit. Records are maintained manually in a notebook, ensuring transparency and mutual trust.
process: Fresh milk arrives daily from our farm and trusted local sources
Daily delivery to your doorstep or farm pickup
Monthly billing with credit option for trusted customers
Transparent record keeping in our farm notebook
